name: Recruited Guard

skills.name: Front Defense
skills.description: (Reaction) When hit by an active attack from the front, DMG taken decreased.

skills.name: Defensive Stance
skills.description: (Support) Gains a shield based on HP and a buff for 2 turns.

skills.name: Global Guard
skills.description: (Support) Takes physical attacks for all other allies within 2 tiles. Gains buffs for 3 turns when activated.

skills.name: Knock-Out Blow
skills.description: (Physical DMG) Single-target attack dealing DMG and inflicting a debuff for 1 turn. Range 1-1.

summary: Rare frontline guard with party physical cover (Global Guard).
